name: Standard Physical Seating Assessment (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Good morning. Conducting seating assessment.
Severe lower back pain after 2 hours sitting.
15 degree posterior pelvic tilt observed on MAT exam.

name: Entrance Barrier & Narrow Doorway Assessment (3 Speakers)

transcript.text: Let us check entrance accessibility.
Three steep steps at main entrance with no ramp.
Bathroom doorway width is only 650 mm.

name: Interrupted Speech & Overlapping Cues (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Are you experiencing pressure... [Overlapping speech / transcription uncertainty]
Yes, on my sacrum every afternoon.

name: Quiet Client & Soft Voice (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Can you describe your seating discomfort?
It hurts around my left ischial tuberosity.

name: Complex MAT Exam with Pelvic Obliquity & Rotation (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: MAT exam reveals 10 degree right pelvic obliquity and 5 degree right pelvic rotation.
I lean heavily to the right side when fatigued.

name: Interpreter Assisted Seating Consultation (4 Speakers)

transcript.text: Please ask the client about cushion discomfort.
Client states current gel cushion feels hard and cold.
Yes, gel cushion uncomfortable.

name: Wheelchair Transport & Vehicle Lockdown Barriers (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Do you travel in a WAV vehicle?
Yes, current wheelchair tie-down headrest interferes with vehicle ceiling height.

name: Contradictory Client Statements & Ambiguous Language (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: How many hours do you sit per day?
Maybe 4 hours... actually maybe 8 hours on weekends.

name: Missing Clinical Findings (All Categories Not Stated)

transcript.text: Hello. Today is initial general introduction.
Good morning therapist.

name: Pressure Redistributing Cushion Recommendation (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: I recommend trial of high specification pressure redistributing air-cell cushion.
I agree to try that cushion.

name: Threshold Ramp & OT Referral Action Plan (3 Speakers)

transcript.text: Referral sent to Community OT for modular threshold ramp.
That will help us get into the garden.

name: Postural Support & Trunk Harness Evaluation (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Client requires dynamic chest harness for anterior trunk instability.
My trunk collapses forward when typing.

name: Rapid Speaker Transitions & Interruptions (3 Speakers)

transcript.text: What about footrest height?
Footrests too short... [Overlapping speech / transcription uncertainty]
His knees are pushed up.

name: Elevating Leg Rests & Knee Extension Limits (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Hamstring tightness restricts knee extension to 70 degrees bilaterally.
My legs feel tight when elevated.

name: Powered Wheelchair Joystick Control Assessment (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Hand fatigue noted using standard proportional joystick.
My fingers tire after 15 minutes of driving.

name: Environmental Gradient & Carpet Surface Drag (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: High pile carpet inside living room increases rolling resistance.
It is exhausting to self-propel over the carpet.

name: Custom Molded Seating Clinic Follow-up (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Custom carved foam seat insert requested due to severe scoliosis.
I need full back contact.

name: Headrest & Cervical Spine Positioning (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: Sub-occipital head support cushion fitted for neck extension support.
My head drops backwards without support.

name: Tilt-in-Space Functional Trial (2 Speakers)

transcript.text: 30 degree tilt-in-space mechanism recommended for periodic weight shifts.
Tilting back gives immediate relief.

name: Comprehensive Multi-Category Discharge Review (3 Speakers)

transcript.text: Summary: Contoured cushion trial approved, ramp referral sent to OT.
Thank you for addressing my sacral pressure pain and step barrier.
We look forward to the ramp installation.
